briefing: Mythos Gates briefing: Elite: Bind the Rune-Mountain Hall: Warden Duel. Enter Rune-Mountain Hall on Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet through The Thunder-Oath Gate while the Gate remains Ruin Gate with active oath memory. Reference deity voice is Frigg, but the player still chooses one deity from the faction roster. Objective: With one selected deity, defeat the elite lock against Valkyrie Weatherfield Exile inside the elite-tuned Rune-Mountain Hall and prove the active deity can endure the trial alone.

missionIntro.speaker: Frigg Divine Voice
missionIntro.text: The oath hears footsteps before thunder. The Rune-Mountain Hall will know whether one deity is enough.

enemyIntroduction.speaker: Lore Director
enemyIntroduction.text: Enemies are not filler here; they are the elite pressure of Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet made hostile.

midBattle.speaker: Gameplay Director
midBattle.text: Read the room law first: Exploit or avoid the route rule: runes that bind promises into flesh

victory.speaker: Frigg Divine Voice
victory.text: The storm has heard the oath and left it standing.

defeat.speaker: Frigg Divine Voice
defeat.text: Withdraw. The The Thunder-Oath Gate has learned too much from this attempt.

codex.speaker: Lore Director
codex.text: The Storm-Rooted Aesir Holds is the source Realm; mortal myth is only the later echo. This beat documents Rune-Mountain Hall as part of Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet.

soloTitanPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Deity language is excluded from standard mission combat.
visualDirection: Frame Rune-Mountain Hall as a elite node in Thunder-Oath Root Gauntlet; storm-iron mail, oath-ring collars, raven and wolf omen shapes, world-root veins, Valkyrie wing-weather, thunder scars, frost-giant mass, shield-wall geometry, ash wood, funeral flame, runes burned as physical wounds not UI glow.

mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.speakerRule: Use faction divine voice, Lore Director, or Gameplay Director; no playable Titan language.
mythosGatesDialogueRecreation.soloRule: Dialogue supports one active god or goddess in the field.

soloDeityPolicy: Dialogue supports one active battlefield deity; roster/Titan language is excluded from player-facing copy except legacy IDs.
